text:
Anya (Product): Heads up — BeaconCorp pushed a pilot ask: private deployment with HSM-backed KMS (or BYOK fallback), per-tenant KV cache, and 100ms P95 SLA for gen requests. They want a pilot next week. Need a quick scope + owners decision.

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Quick take: HSM calls add ~15-25ms on each key op depending on network. Per-tenant KV cache is feasible but multiplies memory usage. Need to decide model variant + quantization to meet 100ms.

Mike (Infra): For private infra to hit 100ms P95 we need reserved GPUs in the target region + prewarm. Canary buffer 2x baseline. Procurement/provisioning lead time: ~10 business days if we follow normal flow. Could accelerate to 5bd with exec sign-off.

Lina (Security): HSM integration + attestation + docs is ~3 weeks (certs + review). We can do a pilot with customer-managed KMS (BYOK) under a temporary exception but need an audit trail and key rotation policy.

Carol (Eng-SRE): Observability requirements: per-tenant latency dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, and alert at 120ms. Need canary + auto-fallback to hosted model if we exceed latency. Also want a smoke test harness for load testing.

Anya (Product): Framing tradeoffs: Option A (fast pilot): BYOK KMS + no HSM, scoped pilot in ~7 business days. Option B (secure): full HSM path, ship in ~4 weeks. Which do we take?

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Option A is much faster. I can add a runtime flag to support BYOK config + cache envelope encryption and a graceful fallback path in ~72h with one engineer. Example config snippet:```yaml
route: /v1/beacon-gen
model: redwood/opt-7b-q4
kms: customer_kms_endpoint
cache: per_tenant
fallback: hosted-model
```

Mike (Infra): If PM signs commit for A, infra can provision reserved nodes and network in 5 business days. If we pick B, lead time goes to ~3w because of HSM certs/procurement.

Lina (Security): For Option A I'll prepare an exception approval template and required audit fields (access logs, envelope keys, rotation window). Can deliver docs in 48h but need legal to OK pilot terms.

Carol (Eng-SRE): Recommend Option A + scoped canary: limit traffic to BeaconCorp + run synthetic spikes to validate P95. I will add dashboards and rollback playbook.

Anya (Product): Decision proposal: go with Option A for pilot (BYOK + per-tenant cache + target 100ms P95). Owners: Sam -> runtime feature flag & fallback; Mike -> reserved infra; Lina -> temp exception & audit; Carol -> canary + dashboards. Everyone ack & ETA? :white_check_mark:

Sam (Eng-Runtime): Ack. ETA 72h for feature flag + fallback and basic tests.

Mike (Infra): Ack. ETA 5 business days for reserved capacity + network config. If we get exec sign-off we can do 3bd.

Lina (Security): Ack. Starting exception paperwork and audit checklist. Draft in 48h.

Carol (Eng-SRE): Ack. Canary runbook and dashboards by Thursday. Will add alerting at 120ms and automated fallback.

ops-bot: Created ticket BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT and assigned owners: https://tickets/BEACON-PRIVATE-PILOT (please add timeline estimates in ticket)

Anya (Product): Thanks all — I'll confirm scope with BeaconCorp: "BYOK KMS + per-tenant KV cache + 100ms P95 target; pilot traffic limited to BeaconCorp." Weekly standups M/W until pilot completes. Re-open thread if blockers. :v:
